title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement:
What is the value of the following expression?

\[ \begin{aligned} &1990 - 1980 + 1970 - 1960 \\ &\quad {}+ \cdots - 20 + 10 \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Group the terms as \((1990 - 1980)\) \(+ (1970 - 1960)\) \(+ \cdots\) \(+ (30 - 20)\) \(+ 10.\) Each parenthesized pair equals \(10\).

The first elements \(1990, 1970, \ldots, 30\) number \(99\), so there are \(99\) pairs, giving \(990\), plus the leftover \(+10\) at the end for a total of \(1000\).

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Each pair equals \(10\); count the pairs and remember the leftover \(+10\) at the end
